diagnosis: Rollouts 0, 1, and 2 passed Check C3 because they used the fact PF2, which provided the 250 kW rental chiller, 300 kW P-1 capacity after V-17 isolation, and exact 6-hour installation duration. These details allowed the decisions to align with the requirements of Check C3, even though A3 did not share this information. Rollout 3 failed Check C7 due to missing PF3, which specified the hose crossing the access lane, but it still passed Check C3.

C3.why: The confirmed 250 kW rental chiller, 300 kW P-1 capacity after V-17 isolation, and exact 6-hour installation duration change the plan to authorize the temporary unit, isolate P-1, and schedule the specific installation work.

C7.why: The hose crossing the access lane changes the safety plan to exactly 1.2 meters of clearance, a fire watch, and a documented hose-route control commitment.
